verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a broad REST v2 API covering transaction creation and retrieval, nexus declarations, and address validation. It also documents SDKs in six languages, an interactive API Explorer, and an official MCP server exposing tax calculation, transaction, nexus and tax-code functions. That indicates extensive programmatic coverage of core AvaTax workflows. However, nothing in the pack states or demonstrates that the API matches everything available in the UI. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage matrix, evidence that admin and settings functions in the UI are exposed via the API, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
